description: Low-code Gemini Enterprise video producer that turns campaign briefs and seed visuals into brand-governed Veo short-form promos using text-to-video, image-to-video, and first-to-last frame transitions.

starter_prompts.title: Launch Teaser Clip (Text-to-Video)
starter_prompts.prompt: Pull our latest campaign brief from Google Drive or Confluence, draft a 3-beat storyboard with camera and lighting cues, and generate the opening promotional clip using Veo.

starter_prompts.title: Animate Hero Still (Image-to-Video)
starter_prompts.prompt: Take my uploaded hero visual (or generate a clean start frame first) and animate it with Veo using subtle parallax camera motion and brand-aligned lighting, plus social caption copy.

starter_prompts.title: Product Reveal Transition (First-to-Last Frame)
starter_prompts.prompt: Design a seamless first-to-last frame transition in Veo moving from a macro glass detail opening frame to a clean minimalist end-card frame ready for our CTA super.

starter_prompts.title: Vertical 9:16 Social Reel Package
starter_prompts.prompt: Build a 12-second 9:16 vertical social reel plan (3 x 4-second Veo clips) from our Slack/Confluence launch notes, including voiceover script, timed supers, and Veo renders.
